text: Binary row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parsed): 1 if at least one comment introduces concrete, personal labor-process details, meaning specific, particular descriptions of how work is actually done (tasks, workplace procedures, working conditions, job experiences) drawn from the commenter's own or a specifically described person's experience. Abstract generalities about work, hypothetical or invented scenarios, and purely normative principles don't qualify; quoted text from others counts only if the commenter adopts it as their own experience. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution text and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is neither positive evidence nor an outcome announcement. List order is irrelevant. Returns 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment qualifies; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.
